title: ModelVersion.to_proto must assign the nested deployment job state, not discard it
answers: deployment job state lost after get_model_version over REST
model version deployment job comes back empty when fetched from the registry
body:
Symptom: A model version that has a deployment job is fetched back through the REST registry and shows a blank job (empty job id, unspecified job and run states). No error is raised.
Root cause: mlflow/entities/model_registry/model_version.py:ModelVersion.to_proto called ModelVersionDeploymentJobState.to_proto(...) and dropped the returned message instead of assigning it into model_version.deployment_job_state, so the field was never set.
Fix pattern: Assign the nested entity proto into the parent with CopyFrom (model_version.deployment_job_state.CopyFrom(self.deployment_job_state.to_proto())). In ModelVersion.from_proto, guard the nested read with proto.HasField("deployment_job_state") and return None otherwise, so a version without a deployment job round-trips to None instead of an empty object.
Constraints: Applies to singular message fields; repeated fields such as aliases use extend instead. Because the bug is silent, round-trip tests must assert HasField on the proto and equality after from_proto. RegisteredModel.to_proto already does this correctly and is the sibling to match.
applies: Entity-to-proto and proto-to-entity conversion of ModelVersion in the OSS model registry entities.
says: The deployment job details for a model version appear completely blank after refreshing.
Model version deployment status shows unspecified run states and missing job identifier.
Ensure deployment job status is preserved when loading registered model version details.
Fetching a deployed model version from the registry loses its active deployment job.
Model registry should display the associated deployment job instead of empty fields.
search: In OSS model registry entity-to-proto conversion, ModelVersion.to_proto must assign the nested ModelVersionDeploymentJobState proto into model_version.deployment_job_state using CopyFrom rather than dropping it. ModelVersion.from_proto must guard the nested read with proto.HasField("deployment_job_state") and return None otherwise. This rule applies to singular message fields in mlflow/entities/model_registry/model_version.py, whereas repeated fields like aliases use extend. Round-trip tests must assert HasField on the proto and equality after from_proto, matching RegisteredModel.to_proto.
